close_reason: Re-baseline (PKIX-lwr9.6, 2026-05-11) eliminated this entire bucket. Zero of the 8 'path length exceeds maximum' cases this bead was framed around are present in the post-.6 StricterThanWild residuals. Like PKIX-lwr9.2, the failures were the harness bypassing pkix-path-builder, not a missing pathLenConstraint backtracking feature. Closing as phantom problem per the empirical re-baseline.
description:
## Why

8 bettertls::pathbuilding cases fail with 'path length exceeds maximum.' pkix-path-builder currently builds a candidate chain, hands it to pkix-path, and pkix-path errors on pathLen — but pkix-path-builder doesn't backtrack to try an alternative chain that would satisfy pathLen.

RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 (BasicConstraints pathLenConstraint) is enforced by pkix-path correctly. The fix is in pkix-path-builder: when a candidate chain would violate pathLen, try a shorter alternative path if one exists in the bundle.

## What

1. Augment pkix-path-builder's candidate-selection logic to check pathLenConstraint against the depth-from-anchor metric BEFORE handing the chain to pkix-path.
2. If a candidate intermediate at depth D would violate the anchor's (or an upstream CA's) pathLen, try the next candidate at that hop (typically a shorter alternative path through a different intermediate). Self-issued certs are exempt from pathLen counting per RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9.
3. Surface pathLen-aware path selection as part of the cross-signed-candidate-selection machinery from PKIX-lwr9.2 — same backtracking mechanism, different filter.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The 8 'path length exceeds maximum' bettertls cases flip to Pass.
- [ ] Self-issued-cert exemption from pathLen counting is implemented and tested.
- [ ] No regression on PKITS §4.6 pathLen tests.
- [ ] No regression on baseline limbo cases.

## Depends on

PKIX-lwr9.1 (fixtures + test scaffolding), PKIX-lwr9.2 (backtracking mechanism — pathLen-aware path selection layers on top of candidate-selection).

## Filed by

PKIX-lwr9 decomposition decision 2026-05-11 (Mark).

These children are blocked by PKIX-lwr9.6 (limbo harness wiring) and will either become genuine builder bugs to fix or close as superseded once .6 re-baselines.
title: pkix-path-builder: pathLenConstraint-aware backtracking
